blocks.text: Fridge aur air conditioner ke compressors aam taur par single phase motors istemal karte hain jo khud se chalna shuru karne mein mushkil mehsoos karti hain. In mein zyada capacitance wale capacitors lagaye jate hain. Kitab ke mutabiq aisa capacitor bohat si electrical energy store kar ke compressor ki motor winding ko deta hai, aur motor ke liye “jump start” (shuru ka dhakka) ban kar use ghumana shuru karwata hai. Asal mein yeh bhi pankhe wale capacitor ki tarah kaam karta hai: starting winding ke current ka phase khiska kar motor ko starting torque (ghumane wala zor) deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke yeh capacitor bohat si energy de kar motor ko “jump start” deta hai. Asal mein yeh motor ko izafi energy nahi deta; starting winding ke current ka phase khiska kar ghoomti magnetic field banata hai, jis se motor ko starting torque milta hai.

Jab motor aik khaas speed (raftar) tak pohanch jaye to relay (aik automatic switch) capacitor ko alag kar deta hai, kyunke ab us ki zaroorat nahi. Isay “start capacitor” kehte hain. Aksar fridge aur air conditioners mein “run capacitor” bhi hota hai jo hamesha circuit mein juda rehta hai aur energy efficiency (bijli ki bachat) barhata hai. Kuch purane models mein sirf start capacitor hota hai jo sirf start par kaam karta hai.

blocks.text: Capacitor aur resistor mil kar time delay circuit bana sakte hain (RC time constant ki wajah se). Fridge, air conditioner aur doosri devices mein yeh bijli on hone mein delay (thori der) daalta hai, taake power fluctuation (bijli ka achanak utaar charhao) se device mehfooz rahe.
